definitions.explanation: Requiring little effort, time, or expense; accessible and practical.

examples.japanese: {手軽|てがる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}れる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a recipe I can make easily.

examples.japanese: {手軽|てがる}な⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}える→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: You can buy it at an affordable price.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手軽|てがる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べられる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧だ。
examples.english: It's an era when you can easily look up information on your smartphone.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧ (light)

Implies something that doesn't burden the hands, i.e., easy to handle.
- {手軽|てがる}な + noun - easy/convenient (modifier)
- {手軽|てがる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb - easily (adverb)
- {手軽|てがる}さ - convenience (noun)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手軽|てがる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}められる→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧ - can be started easily
- {手軽|てがる}な⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ - easy cooking
- {手軽|てがる}な⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ - affordable price
- {手軽|てがる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ - can be enjoyed easily

USAGE:
Often used in advertising and marketing to appeal to convenience. Implies accessibility without much preparation or expertise.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧ - simple, easy
- ⟦{気軽|きがる}→気軽：06865_kigaru⟧ - casual, lighthearted
- お{手軽|てがる} - convenient (slightly more polite/commercial)
